title: Stealing second base with the ancient Greeks
How ancient teeth are changing what we know about early drug use
description: Scientists say ancient people may have used a nut with psychoactive properties for pain relief.

title: Global Heatwave Reaches Record-Breaking Extremes as Fossil Fuel Emissions and Super El Nino Intensify
description: Scientists alert that August 2026 marked the hottest month on record worldwide, with ocean temperatures soaring and a powerful El Nino contributing to extreme weather across continents. The report warns that further temperature records will likely break unless fossil fuel use is curtailed.

title: New fossil discovery in SW China offers insights into ancient human evolution
description: KUNMING, Sept. 10 (Xinhua) -- Scientists have discovered the first-ever fossil of a Denisovan forearm bone in southwest China's Yunnan Province. This discovery provides new insights into how these mysterious ancient human relatives lived and adapted to their environments. The new study, led by researchers from the Institute of Vertebrate Paleontology and Paleoanthropology (IVPP) of the Chinese Academy of Sciences
